# Superstacks 6.1.0

Verification loops, hard constraints, coordinator skills, and a trust ladder.

This tag is for the owner to create later. The stacked PR does not push `v6.1.0`.

## Additions

- Model-invoked `verify-loop` plus `verify.py` / `verify.sh` / Playwright snapshot-console template
- `mistake-to-constraint`, `steer-miner`, `intake-triage`, `gardening`, `sample-review`
- PR body and pipeline status checkers
- `trust_level` 1–3 in safety-overrides and the workflow profile
